content.text:
T = req.get("time")
            if type(fid) is not int or fid < 0 or fid > IDMAX:
                fatal()
            if type(T) is not int or T < 0 or T > TIMAX or T < cur_time:
                fatal()
            fl = flows.get(fid)
            if fl is None:
                fatal()
            cur_time = T
            if heap and (heap[0] >> 31) < T - IT:
                expire(T)
            if fl[3] is None:
                c = evalfb(fl[9])
                fl[3] = c
                fl[4] = 4
                fl[5] = None
                fl[6] = fl[0]
                fl[7] = T
                events.append({"type": "decision", "flow": fid, "class": c,
                               "reason": "end", "at": fl[0], "time": T,
                               "rule": None})
            events.append({"type": "closed", "flow": fid, "packets": fl[0],
                           "matches": fl[8], "class": fl[3],
                           "reason": REASONS[fl[4]], "rule": fl[5]})
            del flows[fid]

        elif op == "checkpoint":
            if nk != 1:
                fatal()
            valid = []
            for k in heap:
                la = k >> 31
                fid = k & 2147483647
                fl = flows.get(fid)
                if fl is not None and fl[3] is None and fl[1] == la:
                    valid.append(k)
            if len(valid) > 1:
                valid = list(set(valid))
                valid.sort()
            heap[:] = valid
            heapify(heap)
            flist = []
            for fid, fl in flows.items():
                flist.append([fid, fl[0], fl[1], fl[8],
                              -1 if fl[3] is None else fl[3], fl[4],
                              -1 if fl[5] is None else fl[5],
                              fl[6], fl[7], fl[11], fl[9], list(fl[10])])
            val = {"t": cur_time, "h": valid, "f": flist}
            ob.write(b'{"checkpoint":'
                     + json.dumps(val, separators=(",", ":")).encode("ascii")
                     + b'}\n')
            ob.flush()
            started = True
            continue

        elif op == "restore":
            if nk != 2 or started:
                fatal()
            cv = req.get("checkpoint")
            if type(cv) is not dict:
                fatal()
            try:
                ntime = cv["t"]
                if type(ntime) is not int or ntime < 0:
                    raise Bad()
                nh = list(cv["h"])
                nf = {}
                for st in cv["f"]:
                    # st = [fid, n, last, matches, dc, drs, drule, dat, dtm,
                    #       fwd, pre, tail]
                    pre = list(st[10])
                    tl = deque(st[11], maxlen=LMAX)
                    D = 0
                    for f in st[11]:
                        D = (((D << 1) | INIT) & MASKS[f + 2048])
                    nf[st[0]] = [st[1], st[2], D,
                                 None if st[4] < 0 else st[4], st[5],
                                 None if st[6] < 0 else st[6],
                                 st[7], st[8], st[3], pre, tl, st[9]]
                heap[:] = nh
                heapify(heap)
                cur_time = ntime
                flows = nf
            except Exception:
                fatal()

        else:
            fatal()

        started = True
        if events:
            ob.write(b'{"events":'
                     + json.dumps(events, separators=(",", ":")).encode("ascii")
                     + b'}\n')
        else:
            ob.write(b'{"events":[]}\n')
        ob.flush()


def main():
    argv = sys.argv
    if len(argv) >= 2 and argv[1] == "compile":
        do_compile()
    elif len(argv) >= 3 and argv[1] == "stream":
        run_stream(argv[2])
    else:
        raise SystemExit(2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
